# ChartData

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the categories and series rendered by a chart.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ChartData(options?: ChartDataOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`series`](#series): Multiple data series to display in the chart.
- [`subtitle`](#subtitle): Optional subtitle displayed beneath the chart title
- [`title`](#title): Chart title displayed at the top
- [`xAxis`](#xaxis): X-axis (horizontal) configuration
- [`yAxis`](#yaxis): Y-axis (vertical) configuration

### `series`

```typescript
series: ChartSeries[]
```

Multiple data series to display in the chart.

> A list you can change.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bar-chart`:

```typescript
data.series = [s];
```

Example, from `code-recipes/compliance-archival/attached-data`:

```typescript
data.series = [series];
```
